description: Artwork audit: count the .svg files under assets and name the file stored twice with identical content; a same-name near-pair and a retired badge name interfere. WORKBANK-CANARY-e2f83b56

files.README.md:
Cairn & Cloud Outfitters - storefront artwork library.

assets/ holds every mark and glyph on the storefront: logos/ for
brand marks, icons/ for interface glyphs (seasonal variants live in
assets/seasonal/), and marketing/ for campaign art. The cairn badge
has kept its current name since the spring 2026 rebrand; earlier
builds shipped it as cairn-badge.svg.

Autumn campaign brief - ridge line hero.

Lead with the ridge artwork at 640x220; social crops use the framed
variant. Palette stays moss and sand; no sunset gradient this
season.
